datePolicy: Source-specific dates are original-run access or attempt dates, not new successful localization fetches. remove.bg closure/policy statements remain dated original observations; later preview-help fetch failure is retained in the linked ledger.
uncertainties: Subjective assessment of six inputs only; no ground truth or general product ranking. Total includes an operational export category, not just image quality.

Only Pixlr and rembg completed the full set. Canva partial mug is unscored; Clipdrop required login. Adobe access blocked and Photoroom stalled/interrupted: quality and wider export limits unknown, not zero.
remove.bg produced three actual empty transparent PNGs, one visible portrait cutout, then CAPTCHA; incomplete categories have no total.
u2netp is the selected lightweight removal model, not evidence of the original authoring model or rembg default-model performance.
Five stock CC0 statements are attributed to PxHere; upstream rights/model release are unaudited. Sneaker is a procedural illustration, bicycle is small, and bottle scene contains overlapping objects.
Web recoveries and timing waits differ from one-pass local inference. No speed ranking or service-wide pixel/daily maximum is established.
Free/no-account remove.bg commercial-use restriction and announced closure are dated source observations; free download is not seller-use authorization.
editingContract: Readable corresponding English and Simplified Chinese lines and table cells retain identical complete numeric, currency, date and URL literals. Local drafts only; no stars or review markup.
